content:
Out of curiosity, is there a reason circleIntegral is defined using intervalIntegral instead of using integral directly? The interval (0, 2pi] is of course never empty, so it seems like using intervalIntegral just adds unnecessary machinery.

The reason I ask is that it would be nice to have an analogous multidimensional version of circleIntegral, but right now that would mean making a multidimensional version of intervalIntegral. Presumably, this would be a sum over all 2ⁿ orientations of the interval, which might be needlessly complicated.
